info.name: DIBBs eCR Refiner app-notifications Query API

params.name: fhir_server
params.description: Name of the FHIR server to query

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the query to use

params.name: given
params.description: Patient given name. At least one of the patient identifier params are required

params.name: family
params.description: Patient family name. At least one of the patient identifier params are required

params.name: dob
params.description: Patient date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. At least one of the patient identifier params are required

params.name: mrn
params.description: Patient medical record number. At least one of the patient identifier params are required

params.name: phone
params.description: Patient phone number. At least one of the patient identifier params are required

items.docs: A GET endpoint that accepts a series of query parameters to execute a query within the Query Connector. At least one of the patient identifier params are required
